profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Clear Demand
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with nearly a decade of experience building and scalable applications across diverse domains. Skilled in Python, JavaScript, and SQL with a strong background in designing reliable, high-performance systems. I bring a proven track record of delivering production-ready solutions, optimizing performance.

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington Bothell. Passionate about exploring new areas of technology and applying engineering expertise to solve complex problems at scale.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built an agentic AI assistant leveraging Google ADK to explain pricing analytics, translating natural language queries into SQL across large-scale BigQuery datasets with automated data ingestion pipelines.

• Developed a secure, internal authentication framework leveraging AWS Cognito for user onboarding and access flows with integrated activity tracking and analytics to monitor user behavior and system usage. Implemented custom SSO flows supporting client identity providers using SAML.

• Developed an automated monitoring and alerting system for critical long-running workflows, leveraging Freshdesk APIs for automated incident ticketing and asynchronous messaging to notify relevant stakeholders, reducing overhead from manual monitoring.

• Designed and executed end-to-end migration of distributed applications from AWS to GCP, rehosting Amplify frontends, EC2/Elastic Beanstalk backends, and Lambda-based microservices and related infrastructure to equivalent GCP services.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Engineered custom web crawlers to extract and normalize product and pricing data from multiple CPG websites, ensuring high data accuracy and scalability across diverse site architectures.

• Designed and built a full-stack platform for product matching, enabling clients to map their SKUs against competitor catalogs.
  o Implemented a multi-user verification process for external QA and final approval of automated matches & non-automated matches.
  o Developed an automated reporting subsystem producing daily and on-demand reports across multiple metrics, including match accuracy, match coverage, review performance, and category-level analytics.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Debugged front end & middle tier code in Java, JavaScript, Python, Bash and SQL based on incidents reported by customers and test engineers – received outstanding performance review for highest number of incidents solved by a new employee during 90-day onboarding review.
•	Implemented front end for displaying cellphones active on 2G and 3G bands that have been captured on Tecore’s iNAC system. Used Google Maps Static Image API to mark each cellphone’s geolocation on a map.
•	Developed a web application in Java, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS to enable users to use a browser client to connect to our servers. Used Undertow for the backend server and Thymeleaf templating engine to reconcile Java frontend and HTML. Implemented responsive CSS using Bootstrap across all platforms (PC, Android, iOS).
•	Implemented an API in Java to allow users to connect to our servers/databases remotely by passing XML or JSON queries.
